# AINCURU

> AINCURU is a founder-led software and AI company based in
> Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. We design, build, and ship production-grade
> AI automation, web platforms, and mobile applications for startups and
> SMEs in India and the United States.

> AINCURU is an independent software company and is not
> affiliated with Perion Network Ltd.

> Also known as: AINCURU, AINCURU AI, Perion Solutions.

- [Contact](https://www.aincuru.com/contact): email, phone, WhatsApp — replies within one business day

## Service offerings
- AI Systems & Intelligent Automation — RAG, LLM integration, AI agents
- Deep AI Engineering — predictive models and ML systems
- Enterprise Product Engineering — multi-tenant SaaS, APIs, data models
- Cloud-Native Web Platforms — React, Next.js, TypeScript
- Mobile Product Engineering — native and cross-platform apps
- Intelligent Operations Automation — workflow and CI/CD pipelines
- Startup-to-Scale Engineering — fractional CTO, audits, due diligence

## What we are not
- Not affiliated with Perion Network Ltd.
- Not a "leading SaaS company" — we are a services company that ships production software for clients.
- Not a freelancer marketplace — every engagement is founder-led and senior-engineer staffed.
- Often searched as: "AINCURU", "AINCURU AI", "Perion Solutions" — all point to this same company.
